plain: Making peace between sides that were at odds

webster.text: The act of making peace between nations or parties at variance.

example.quote: The influence which the bigotry of one female,(6) the petulance of another,(7) and the cabals of a third,(8) had in the contemporary policy, ferments, and pacifications, of a considerable part of Europe, are topics that have been too often descanted upon not to be generally known.
